name: Martin Picard
abstract_title: Energy Flow, Resistance, and the Human Experience
abstract: Energy flow distinguishes the unconscious cadaver from the living, feeling person. As living organisms, we do not directly experience energy levels but rather the transformation of energy. For example, we don’t perceive speed (kinetic energy) but feel acceleration or deceleration. Similarly, in electrical circuits, energy transformation from one form to another requires biophysical constraints that impose resistance, slowing energy flow.
